title: Zesty Creamy Argentinian Soya Bean Stew
description: A comforting, earthy stew inspired by traditional locro techniques, using emulsified coconut cream and lemon for a bright Whole30 finish.
instructions: Sauté the diced onion and garlic in olive oil over medium heat until translucent.
Stir in the smoked paprika and cubed sweet potato to coat them in the oil.
Add the soaked soya beans and vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for sixty minutes until beans are tender.
Transfer two cups of the stew base to a blender and process until completely smooth.
Return the pureed mixture to the pot to create a thick and creamy consistency.
Slowly whisk in the coconut milk and remaining olive oil to emulsify the broth.
Stir in the fresh lemon juice to brighten the earthy flavors of the beans.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste while the stew thickens.
Ladle the stew into bowls and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
